audit.whatIsWrong: This side disagreed with the already-audited mirror on three rows. trundle__renekton set the chart to Skill / Renekton / Renekton / Skill / Renekton / Trundle / Trundle; this page had Skill at Level 6 and Renekton at both item stages.
audit.why: Dominus answers Subjugate at 6, so that row is Renekton's; once Trundle has an item and Frozen Domain up he wins the sustained duel, so both item rows are his.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Renekton (7/10), First item to Trundle (3/10), 2+ items to Trundle (3/10) — both layers, one atomic group, matching the mirror exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic 'Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes' line with no reference to Subjugate.
audit.why: The mirror rewrote level 6 as 'answer R with R' with Dominus's 120/100/80 named; this side needs the same framing so the two pages describe one fight.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around Dominus at 120s versus Subjugate's four-second stat drain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frozen Domain is described only as move-speed and attack-speed. Riot's text also gives increased healing from ALL sources while he stands on it — the page never says so, even though it prescribes anti-heal. Subjugate is described vaguely as 'steals your stats' without the armour/MR specifics or its 120s cooldown.
audit.why: The healing amplification is precisely why Executioner's Calling must be bought before you duel him on the patch, and it is the reason his sustain beats your Q heal after first item.
audit.corrected: Healing amplification written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d and whys[5]; Subjugate's armour/MR theft and 120s cooldown written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and phases[6].why.
sources: champ-data/_kits/trundle.json (W text and cd 18/17/16/15/14, R text and cd 120/100/80)

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags resistances-invalidated against King's Tribute and Subjugate.
audit.why: late already says 'do not build pure tank in this lane' and report[8].t carries Executioner's Calling early, so the rule is satisfied.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'Use Pillar of Ice' as a probable wrong name.
audit.why: False positive — Pillar of Ice is Trundle's real E.
audit.corrected: Name kept. Whether that terrain actually blocks Slice and Dice is not answerable from the kit data, so — as the mirror did — I left every claim about the pillar walling your dash untouched rather than strengthening or removing it.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Trundle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Answer his R with yours: Dominus is 120s at rank 1, and its HP plus Fury ramp beats Subjugate's four-second stat drain.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Subjugate's cooldown.
edits.after: Eclipse helps you, but his first item and Frozen Domain now win the longer duel.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Trundle carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, Subjugate farms your resistances every cast — carry threat 7/10, so play the map, not the side lane.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. Bully him before 6. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Trundle Subjugate: 120s at rank 1, and it steals armour and MR — do not build pure tank into it. - Frozen Domain: 18s, and it raises his healing from every source, so anti-heal goes in before you duel him on it.

edits.before: Steals your stats. Bully him before 6. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Steals armour and MR over 4 seconds — 120s at rank 1. Fight before it.

edits.before: That is Trundle's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Frozen Domain raises all his healing and speed — never duel on the patch.

edits.before: Track Trundle's Subjugate: Steals your stats. Bully him before 6. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Subjugate steals armour and MR — 120s at rank 1. Frozen Domain raises all his healing: anti-heal first.

edits.before: First item brings his damage up and your burst edge narrows — both of you can trade, but anti-heal cuts his Q-bite recovery; it is genuinely even who wins the extended fight.
edits.after: First item brings his damage up and your burst edge narrows — Frozen Domain amplifies every heal he takes, so without anti-heal already bought the extended fight is his.

notes: Chart now matches the already-audited mirror trundle__renekton row for row, including the two item stages this side had wrongly given to Renekton. The unstated mechanic was Frozen Domain increasing his healing from all sources — the actual justification for the Executioner's Calling line the page already carried. Per the mirror's flag, I did not assert anything about Pillar of Ice blocking Slice and Dice, or about a Slice and Dice recast; neither is answerable from the kit data.
